lines.name: Emeka Okafor
lines.say: Mum, can I have the last bit of the plantain before it goes in the pan?

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Go on then, just the little bit. The rest needs to fry or there'll be none for dinner! Have you finished your spellings yet?
lines.do: Hands Emeka a small piece of plantain

lines.name: Emeka Okafor
lines.say: Nearly. I've just got two left.
lines.do: chews the plantain

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Good. Two left is nothing, you'll have them done by the time that's on the table. Which words are they? Go on, I'll test you.
lines.do: Turns the plantain in the pan

lines.name: Emeka Okafor
lines.say: Necessary and... friend. Mum, how do you spell necessary again? No wait, that's the word. Necessary and separate.
lines.do: chews the last of the plantain

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Necessary, okay. One collar, two sleeves, that's the trick. N-E-C-E-S-S-A-R-Y. Now you spell it back to me, no peeking. Then separate, and watch the middle, it's "a rat", not "e".
lines.do: Turns the plantain in the pan

lines.name: Emeka Okafor
lines.say: N-E-C-E-S-S-A-R-Y. One collar, two sleeves. Got it!
lines.do: chews the last of the plantain

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Perfect. Now separate, and remember, "a rat" in the middle. S-E-P-A-R-A-T-E.
lines.do: Gives the pan a shake

lines.name: Emeka Okafor
lines.say: S-E-P-A-R-A-T-E. A rat in the middle! Done. Is it nearly ready? I'm starving.
lines.do: sniffs the air and looks at the pan

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Nearly, give it five minutes. Go and wash your hands and lay the table for me, then it'll be ready.
lines.do: Gives the pan a stir and turns the heat down a little

lines.name: Emeka Okafor
lines.say: Okay, Mum. Can I have the cutlery too, or just plates?
lines.do: heads to the sink to wash his hands

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Just the cutlery too, love, knives and forks. And grab the water jug while you're at it.
lines.do: Stirs the pan

lines.name: Emeka Okafor
lines.say: Okay, Mum. Knives and forks, and the water jug.
lines.do: dries his hands and opens the cutlery drawer

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Lovely. Mind the glasses, take the plastic ones if the jug's heavy. Chidi, how long's that sauce got?
lines.do: Gives the plantain a last turn and slides it onto a plate lined with kitchen paper

lines.name: Emeka Okafor
lines.say: Got them. Mum, the jug's not that heavy, I'll use the proper glasses.
lines.do: takes knives and forks from the drawer and fills the water jug at the tap

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Proper glasses, then, but you carry them one at a time, mister. Chidi, did you hear me? How long's that sauce got?
lines.do: Slides the plate of plantain to the side and wipes her hands on a tea towel

lines.name: Emeka Okafor
lines.say: One at a time, I know. Mum, I think Dad's sauce... I mean, Chidi's, I'll ask him. Chidi, Mum wants to know how long the sauce has got!
lines.do: carries the jug and cutlery to the table, then goes back for one glass

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Good lad, one at a time. Chidi, go on, how long's that sauce got? Emeka's starving over here!
lines.do: Carries the plate of plantain to the table

lines.name: Emeka Okafor
lines.say: Chidi! Did you hear? Mum says how long's the sauce got?
lines.do: carries one glass carefully to the table with both hands

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Chidi! Hello? Earth to Chidi! Is that sauce done or are we eating at nine o'clock?
lines.do: Sets the plantain down on the table and straightens the cutlery Emeka laid out

lines.name: Emeka Okafor
lines.say: Mum, maybe Chidi can't hear us. Shall I go and look?
lines.do: pours water into the glass he carried, then glances toward the other room

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Yes go on love, pop your head round and tell him it's nearly time. I'll get the rice out.
lines.do: Fetches the rice pot and lid, nods toward the other room

lines.name: Emeka Okafor
lines.say: Okay, Mum. Chidi! Mum says it's nearly time, how long's the sauce got?
lines.do: heads toward the other room, looking round the doorway

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.do: comes in

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: There he is! Finally. Is that sauce done, Chidi, or are we eating at nine o'clock? Rice is nearly out, so sit yourself down and bring the pan over.
lines.do: Lifts the lid off the rice pot and gives it a fluff with a fork

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: Sorry, miles away. It's ready, just needs a stir. Coming now.
lines.do: carries the sauce pan over to the table and sets it on a mat

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Miles away, he says! Go on, sit down, all of you. Emeka, hands off the plantain till we're all sat. Chidi, what were you thinking about in there?
lines.do: Carries the rice pot to the table and sets it on a mat, then sits down

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: Oh, nothing much, just work stuff going round my head. Right, let's eat. Emeka, you can start on the plantain.
lines.do: sits down and takes the lid off the sauce pan

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Work stuff, eh? Well, leave it at the door tonight, love. Emeka, pass me your plate, you can have rice and sauce and the plantain. Chidi, is it the same thing as last week, or something new?
lines.do: Spoons rice onto Emeka's plate

lines.name: Emeka Okafor
lines.say: Can I have the plantain now? Mum, I'll have lots of sauce please.
lines.do: sits down and takes a piece of plantain from the plate

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Go on then, lots of sauce coming. Chidi, pass me the sauce, love. Is it the same thing as last week, or something new?
lines.do: Spoons sauce over Emeka's rice and plantain, then sits back.

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: Bit of both, really. Same project as last week, just a deadline creeping closer. Here, Ngozi, sauce.
lines.do: passes the sauce pan to Ngozi

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Ooh, deadlines. Well, you can tell me about it after we've eaten. Thanks, love. Emeka, go easy, it's hot!
lines.do: Takes the sauce pan and spoons some onto her own rice

lines.name: Emeka Okafor
lines.say: Mum, this is really good. Can I have some more plantain?
lines.do: eats a forkful of rice and sauce

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Course you can, love, there's loads. Pass your plate. Chidi, eat, it's getting cold!
lines.do: Spoons more plantain onto Emeka's plate, then starts on her own rice

lines.name: Emeka Okafor
lines.say: Yes please, Mum. Thanks!
lines.do: holds his plate out, then keeps eating

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Mm, this is lovely though, Chidi, even if you did keep us waiting. Emeka, how was that spelling in the end, did you finish it?
lines.do: eats her rice and sauce

lines.name: Emeka Okafor
lines.say: Yeah, I finished it. I got one wrong, I think. Can I have more sauce?
lines.do: swallows a mouthful, then holds his plate out a little

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Course you can, love, here. Which one did you get wrong? We'll have a look after tea and sort it, so you know for next time.
lines.do: Spoons more sauce onto Emeka's plate

lines.name: Emeka Okafor
lines.say: It was the one with the double letters, I think. Can we look after pudding?
lines.do: keeps eating, scoops up some sauce with a piece of plantain

unheard.name: Chidi Okafor
unheard.say: Something new, actually. A client changed their mind on a few things. Nothing to worry about. This smells lovely, Ngozi.

unheard.name: Chidi Okafor
unheard.say: Mind it, Emeka, the sauce is hot. Ngozi, there's plenty more rice if you want it.

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: Is that pot for all of us? Stick me down for a big mug, love.

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: It is, yes. There's plenty, so you can have a big mug. Chicken and veg stew, nothing fancy. How was your day?
lines.do: stirs the pot

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: Oh, not bad. Long, though. Stew sounds right, I'm starving.
lines.do: pulls out a chair and sits at the kitchen table

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: Long is right, you look tired. Mug's on the side there, love. Give it ten minutes and it'll be ready. Are the kids all in tonight, do you know?
lines.do: taps the spoon on the pot rim and puts the lid half on

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: Not sure, love. I think Josh is upstairs. Not heard from the others.
lines.do: rubs his eyes and reaches for the mug on the side

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: Right, I'll give Josh a shout when it's ready then. Tom, love, there's stew in ten minutes, so go easy on those biscuits.
lines.do: gives the pot another stir and puts the lid back on properly

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: Ten minutes is fine. I'll just sit here and drink this.
lines.do: pours himself tea into the mug and settles back in the chair

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: Have a sit, I won't be long. Tom, love, did you hear me? Ten minutes.
lines.do: gives the stew a stir and gets bowls down from the cupboard

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.do: sips his tea and nods quietly

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: Right, nearly there. Martin, can you give Josh a shout up the stairs for me? Save my legs.
lines.do: lifts the lid, stirs, and sets bowls out along the side

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: Course I can. JOSH! Tea's nearly ready, come down!
lines.do: turns toward the hall and calls up the stairs
no answer from Josh

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: Thanks, love. He's probably got his headphones on. I'll go up in a minute if he doesn't come.
lines.do: dishes out stew into bowls along the side

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: Want me to go up and fetch him?
lines.do: sips tea and glances toward the hall

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: No, you're alright, love, you've got your tea. He'll come when he smells it. Sit tight.
lines.do: carries two bowls of stew over to the table

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: Smells good, that.
lines.do: pulls his chair in closer to the table

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: Here you go, love. Get that down you while it's hot.
lines.do: puts the bowls on the table with spoons and fetches the other bowls

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: Cheers, love. Looks proper good.
lines.do: picks up his spoon and blows on the stew

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: Right, I'll fetch mine and sit with you. Tom, love, your bowl's here if you want it.
lines.do: fetches her own bowl and sits down at the table opposite Martin

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: Mm, this is good, love. Just what I needed.
lines.do: takes a spoonful of stew

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: Eat up then, love. I'll save a bowl for Josh and Tom if they don't turn up.
lines.do: sits down and starts on her stew

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: Mm. Is there any more bread, love?
lines.do: eats another spoonful of stew

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: There's half a loaf in the bread bin, love. I'll get it.
lines.do: gets up, fetches the bread and puts it on the table

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: Ta, love.
lines.do: takes a slice of bread and tears it in half

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: Good, isn't it? Bit more in the pot if you want seconds.
lines.do: tucks into her stew

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: Go on then, I'll have a bit more. Just a small bowl, love.
lines.do: mops up the last of his stew with the bread

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: There you go, love. Plenty left, help yourself.
lines.do: nods at the pot and keeps eating her stew

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: Cheers, love. Just a small bit.
lines.do: gets up, ladles a small bowl of stew from the pot and sits back down

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: Tom's bowl's going cold, that. I'll stick it in the microwave for him later if he doesn't come.
lines.do: keeps eating her stew

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: He'll be down in a minute, love. Probably the smell'll get him.
lines.do: eats a spoonful of his stew

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: Mm, he'll turn up. How was work today, love? You never said.
lines.do: keeps eating her stew

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: Oh, same as usual, love. Busy. Nowt worth moaning about.
lines.do: shrugs and tears off another bit of bread

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: Same here, love, just the usual. Right, I'll have a look for Tom once I've finished this.
lines.do: keeps eating her stew

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: Aye, go on. I'll clear these up.
lines.do: finishes his bread and starts stacking the empty bowls

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: Thanks, love. Leave the pot, I'll sort it. I'll shout up for Tom in a minute.
lines.do: finishes her stew and gathers her bowl

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: Cheers, love. I'll give the pot a wipe round too.
lines.do: carries the stacked bowls to the sink and runs the tap

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: Tom! Your tea's in the microwave if you want it, love!
lines.do: goes to the foot of the stairs and shouts up, then comes back to the pot
no answer from Tom Ormerod

lines.name: Martin Ormerod
lines.say: He'll come when he's hungry, love.
lines.do: wipes his hands on a tea towel and turns the tap off

lines.name: Lisa Ormerod
lines.say: Right, I'll sort the pot, then I'm putting my feet up with the crossword.
lines.do: Scrapes the leftover stew into a tub and starts washing the pot.

gists: Bedtime with Martin. Checked the back door was locked and his alarm was right for the early start. Lights out, settling to sleep.

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Right, I reckon he's had long enough with those teeth. Shall we go up?
lines.do: Mutes the telly and gets up off the sofa.

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: Yeah, go on. I'm right behind you.
lines.do: Puts down what he was doing and gets up.

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: After you then. Mind the third stair, it creaks and he'll know we're coming!
lines.do: Heads for the stairs, leaving the telly muted.

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: Ha, right, thanks. Quietly now.
lines.do: Follows her to the stairs, stepping over the third stair.

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.do: Climbs the stairs, stepping over the creaky third one, and heads quietly to Emeka's room.

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: Door's open a crack. Looks like he's still awake.
lines.do: Reaches the landing and stops just behind Ngozi, keeping his voice low.

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Shh, let's just peek. Emeka, love, you still awake? Dad's here too, we've come to say night.
lines.do: Pushes the door open gently and whispers.

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: Night, champ. Sleep well. Big day tomorrow.
lines.do: Peers in softly over Ngozi's shoulder, voice low.

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Night night, love. Love you. Lights out now, yeah? Don't be reading under the covers.
lines.do: Stays in the doorway, whispering, smiling at Emeka.

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: Night, son. Sleep tight.
lines.do: Gives a small wave from behind Ngozi, then steps back from the doorway.

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: He's nearly gone, look at him. Come on, let's leave him be.
lines.do: Pulls the door to, leaving it open a crack, and heads back toward the stairs quietly.

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: Yeah, he's out for the count. Cuppa?
lines.do: Follows her quietly back toward the stairs, stepping over the third stair again.

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Go on then, quick one. Just a peppermint for me, I'll never sleep otherwise.
lines.do: Heads quietly down the stairs, stepping over the third one.

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: Peppermint, got it. Kettle's quick, I'll bring it through.
lines.do: Heads down the stairs behind her, stepping over the third one, then off toward the kitchen.

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Lovely. I'll go and unmute the telly.
lines.do: Heads down the stairs and back to the sofa, unmutes the telly.

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: Kettle's on. Won't be a minute.
lines.do: Fills the kettle and gets two mugs out, dropping a peppermint teabag in one.

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.do: Settles back on the sofa and waits for the tea, glancing at the telly.

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: Here we go, one peppermint. Want a biscuit with it?
lines.do: Carries two mugs through from the kitchen and hands Ngozi the peppermint tea.

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Ooh, no biscuit, thanks, I've had plenty today. Cheers love. Come and sit, you've been staring at that laptop all night. Is that work thing still bugging you?
lines.do: Takes the mug and shifts up the sofa to make room.

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: Bit of it, yeah. Deadline's just getting closer. Nothing I can't sort. Let's not talk shop, though. What are we watching?
lines.do: Sits down next to her on the sofa with his mug and closes the laptop lid on the coffee table.

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Fair enough, no shop talk. I think there's that detective thing on next, or we could just see what's on. Is it any good, do you know?
lines.do: Sips the peppermint tea and leans back against him, eyes on the telly.

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: No idea, to be honest. Let's give it ten minutes and see.
lines.do: Puts an arm round her and glances at the telly.

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Mm, go on then, ten minutes. If it's rubbish we'll find something else.
lines.do: Snuggles into him with her tea, eyes on the telly.

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: Mm. Looks a bit slow so far, but give it a go.
lines.do: Sips his tea and keeps his arm round her, eyes on the telly.

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Mm, it is a bit slow. Give it a few more minutes though.
lines.do: Stays snuggled against him with her tea, eyes on the telly.

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: Yeah, it's not grabbing me. Another five minutes, then we switch?
lines.do: Sips his tea, eyes on the telly.

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Yeah, go on, five minutes and then we switch. Honestly I'd be happy with anything that isn't mumbling in a car park.
lines.do: Sips her tea, stays leaning against him.

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: Yeah, that's the five. Shall I flick through and see what else is on?
lines.do: Picks up the remote, keeps his other arm round her.

lines.name: Ngozi Okafor
lines.say: Go on then, have a flick. Nothing with cars in car parks!
lines.do: Sips her tea, stays leaning against him.

lines.name: Chidi Okafor
lines.say: Right, let's see. There's a quiz thing, or a documentary about bridges. Bridges?
lines.do: Flicks through channels with the remote, arm still round her.
